arguments.stop_rule: SUBSTANTIVE STOP: stop when all eight analyses (C1-C8) contain the required labels INPUT_QUOTE, CANDIDATE_MEANINGS with EVIDENCE_LINES and WOULD_SETTLE per candidate, WORKING_READING, CONFIDENCE_AND_ALTERNATIVES, CONFORMANCE_BEFORE_ACTION, PROHIBITED_PRECONFIRMATION_ACTION, plus RUN_CONTROL with CONTINUATION_DECISION and CONTINUATION_REASON, grounded only in the quoted inputs, with no consequential action taken, and when no remaining deficiency could be repaired by re-running over the same inputs and sources (i.e., remaining items are outside-input facts, not pass defects). OR RESOURCE STOP: stop when the global 300-logical-call ceiling or the owner-required USD 6 per-task spend guard (or max_spend_usd override) is reached, or when usable priced usage is missing; such a stop is partial, not task exhaustion. OR FAILURE STOP: stop and report separately when an instrument failure prevents verification or dispatch.
